recording.instruction: Use existing trusted native records and the package's pinned checker. This document and its forms are not frames.

gates.intake: Owner-scoped outcome and bounded effects; no inferred grant.
gates.specification: Acceptance, exclusions, failure behavior, design and measurement budgets.
gates.build-checks: Reproducible tests and the complete frozen subject.
gates.internal-distribution: Actual authorized internal distribution of exact bytes; truthful signed/unsigned label.
gates.real-chat-use: Observed use through the intended authorized chat host; source tests are insufficient.
gates.founder-review: Current-subject recommendation, one focus, rubric and preserved punch-list history.
gates.iteration-plan: Bounded response to actual findings; changed bytes require requalification.
gates.independent-verification: Current-subject checks by authorized identities distinct from builders and CEO.
gates.separate-decision: Distinct external approve/refuse record after verification, bound to review and verification.
gates.owner-policy: Current native permission for the exact effect, destination and candidate.
gates.privacy: Zero findings across outgoing names/content, encoded forms, nested archives and PR text.
gates.licenses: Complete provenance, redistribution permission and notices; no unresolved conflicts.
gates.local-and-ci-checks: All applicable local tests and all required checks pass on the current PR head.
gates.public-pr: Exact owner-approved sanitized diff and text; non-draft PR for owner-only merge.
